scope: Serverless production command activation and completion. Native namespace instructions; Lua companion includes executable VM instructions. Fixture, shared-library bodies, network, io_uring syscalls and idle scheduler work are outside this census. No rates, cycles/op or IPC were measured.
attribution: Every nonzero delta is decomposed exactly into executed-function instruction counts. Function movement/inlining can move instructions between bodies without changing totals. See the linked-body inventory for source/lane versus compiler changes.
